chunks: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were among the doers of good.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between righteous deeds and divine mercy in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Anbiya, this verse underscores the culmination of prophetic intercession and divine grace, linking the status of 'al-salihun' not merely to moral rectitude but to inclusion within the specific sphere of God's mercy. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a testament to the efficacy of righteous deeds in securing a place among those favored by Allah, reinforcing the balance between divine mercy and human effort.
